description: Create an AppLovin Ads campaign, read back PAUSED: AppLovin ignores status on create, so Hermoso pauses it straight after. A WEB campaign needs name, websiteUrl, countries, dailyBudget, goalType and goalValue (CPE also eventTarget; CHK_ROAS also roasDayTarget). APP campaigns add platform, packageName, trackingMethod, clickUrl, impressionUrl (iOS: itunesId). Every field is checked before AppLovin is called. Needs the Campaign Management key, which exists once AppLovin enables API access on the account; without it the answer says how to get it.

biddingStrategy.description: automatic bidding billed per thousand impressions, or target goal billed per install

catalogId.description: product catalog id for DPA or DOA campaigns

catalogType.description: product catalog type: DPA or DOA

clickUrl.description: click-tracking URL from the measurement partner, for app campaigns

countryGoals.description: per-country goal values keyed by ISO code, e.g. {US: 2.5}

dailyBudget.description: account currency per day, all countries

impressionUrl.description: impression-tracking URL from the measurement partner, for app campaigns

itunesId.description: iOS App Store numeric id, for iOS app campaigns

packageName.description: app package name, for app campaigns

trackingMethod.description: mobile measurement partner that tracks installs: ADJUST, APPSFLYER, APSALAR, BRANCH, KOCHAVA or TENJIN

usMetros.description: US metro names such as NEW_YORK; not with usRegions

usRegions.description: US state codes, only with US

variantSetId.description: product variant set id within the catalog

websiteUrl.description: WEB: full landing page URL with tracking parameters

name: create_applovin_ads_campaign
